visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair wearing a black graphic t-shirt and white shorts sits on a grey couch next to a man in a grey t-shirt and black shorts. The room is a bright, modern living room with a kitchen island visible in the background. A red text overlay at the top reads 'When she apologizes.' The woman turns to the man with a slightly regretful expression. (2) The man, holding a smartphone, puts his arm around the woman's shoulder. They both look at the phone screen and smile warmly. The lighting is bright and even. (3) The scene transitions to the same couple on the couch, but the text overlay is now blue and reads 'When I apologize.' The man holds a large plastic bubble tea cup and gestures toward the woman with a pleading expression. The woman is holding her phone and looks indifferent. (4) As the man continues to speak, the woman suddenly kicks her leg out toward him. A visual effect of purple lightning bolts appears around her leg. The man is launched off the couch and disappears from the frame. (5) The woman calmly takes the bubble tea, inserts a black straw, and begins to drink while checking her phone. The man's hand reaches up from the floor at the bottom of the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice says 'I'm sorry' with a calm, slightly submissive tone. The male voice immediately responds 'It's okay' with a warm and forgiving tone. There is a slight laugh from the female at the end. (2) The scene cuts and the male voice begins speaking rapidly and pleadingly, saying 'I'm really sorry... prettiest princess in the world.' His pitch is higher and more frantic. (3) A sharp, synthesized 'Whoosh' SFX triggers as the visual lightning appears. (4) A loud 'Thud' impact SFX follows as the man hits the floor. (5) A distinct 'Pop' sound occurs as a straw is inserted into a cup, followed by an audible 'Slurp' sound as the female drinks. The male makes a faint groaning sound from the background.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Comparison: Scenario A (She apologizes) -> Scenario B (He apologizes).
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A comedic sketch highlighting a perceived relationship double standard where a woman's apology is easily accepted, while a man's apology is met with extreme physical rejection despite his best efforts.
